bootstrap.ci: 2.5/97.5 percentile; fixed selected OOF predictions, no refit/reselection

protocol.clip: float64 per-row L2; no fitting; only selected train/validation values
protocol.convergence_warning: raise and stop, do not alter budget or continue silently
protocol.fusion: concatenate L2 CLIP and scaled PNG block; no final normalization/weight search
protocol.png: StandardScaler fit on current training fold only; divide by sqrt(10 or 9)
protocol.selection: largest pooled train OOF AP per label; tie lower C, then None
protocol.test: no test labels/images/predictions/feature values; no full original NPY hash
protocol.threshold: train OOF F1 max on .05..95 step .01; ties nearest .5, then larger; predict p>=t
protocol.undefined_metrics: AP=None if either truth class absent; P=None if no predicted positive; R=None if no positive; F1=None only if 2TP+FP+FN=0; macros average defined labels and record counts
protocol.validation: freeze all 20 selections/thresholds, fit only train, predict once; load validation truth afterwards
protocol.zero_variance: StandardScaler uses scale_=1; preserve and report zero-variance columns

bootstrap.fixed_decisions: use recorded outer-fold predictions, never reselect thresholds, routes, parameters or refit
bootstrap.missing_ap: if any label lacks either truth class, invalidate whole paired macro-AP replicate; count, no redraw
bootstrap.missing_f1: invalidate paired macro-F1 replicate if any of four label F1 is undefined; no redraw

protocol.clip: float64 per-sample L2 of original center-crop features; no fit
protocol.f1_policy: max inner OOF F1; ties nearest .5 using round(distance,12), then larger threshold
protocol.high_recall_policy: target Recall>=.70; highest eligible threshold; unmet -> .05, explicitly unmet
protocol.hyperparameter_selection: max pooled inner OOF AP per label; ties smaller C then None

loso.label: source-transfer stress test, not independent new-data generalization
loso.rule: once per source; train and select only on other train sources; same inner grouped CV and budgets; no feedback

protocol.low_fpr_policy: target FPR<=.15; lowest eligible threshold; unmet -> .95, explicitly unmet
protocol.page_metrics: all-negative false-alarm denominator=all-negative pages; true-defect page hit=any(y & alert); review=any(alert)/all pages
protocol.png: fold-only StandardScaler then divide sqrt(10), C9 sqrt(9); zero-variance scale=1; concat without new weighting
protocol.policy_scope: inner OOF only; fold-specific thresholds travel unchanged to outer holdout; no tuning on held-out truth
protocol.routing: C iff unrounded C inner OOF AP - A inner OOF AP >= 0.0200; otherwise A; never C9
protocol.undefined_metrics: AP=None if either truth class absent; P=None if no predicted positive; R=None if no positive; F1=None only if 2TP+FP+FN=0; macros average defined labels and record counts
protocol.validation: final full-train inner selection frozen before LOSO and final refit; predict once; load validation truth after all predictions
